step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates an automated compliance and remediation workflow using Dome9 CloudBots and AWS services. Security findings from Dome 9 and AWS GuardDuty are sent to a central input SNS topic. This SNS topic triggers a serverless AWS Lambda function containing the Python/Boto3 CloudBot logic. The Lambda function parses the alert and performs cross-account remediation actions by assuming IAM roles in target AWS accounts (Account 1, Account 2). Upon completing remediation, the Lambda function publishes logs to an output SNS topic, which broadcasts notifications to destinations like email and Slack.

edges.notes: Dome 9 sends non-compliance alerts to the input SNS topic.
GuardDuty sends threat findings to the input SNS topic.
Input SNS topic triggers the CloudBot Lambda function.
Lambda assumes role and applies remediation in Account 1.
Lambda assumes role and applies remediation in Account 2.
Lambda outputs execution status and logs to the output SNS topic.
Output SNS topic delivers remediation notifications to Email and Slack.
